description: This file defines a template class 'BaseRefCount' within the WPEFramework::ProcessContainers namespace. The class implements reference counting functionality by managing an internal counter, with methods to add and release references, and deletes itself when the count reaches zero.

classes.name: BaseRefCount
classes.description: A template class providing reference counting capabilities, inheriting from a Mixin type, with thread-safe increment and decrement operations.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count in a thread-safe manner and deletes the object if the count reaches zero.
